Acts as a strategic link between technical support, operations, commissioning, construction, HSEQ, procurement and logistics teams, ensuring that all deliverables are carried out safely, within the schedule and budget, in compliance with regulatory and contractual requirements and the company's integrity standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain execution plans and the proper allocation of personnel and equipment resources.
  • Monitor activity costs, ensuring all remain within the allocated budget, in conjunction with the company's controllers.
  • Supervise all execution, personnel and equipment mobilization and/or demobilization plans and activities.
  • Present and manage indicators on the monthly progress of activities, with formalization of deliverables by category (engineering, commissioning and construction).
  • Act as the focal point of contact for all activities, managing communications between departments, contractors and other stakeholders.
  • Coordinate and collaborate with procurement and logistics teams on the action plan to ensure the timely availability of resources for activities.
  • Coordinate, supervise the performance of and provide guidance to third parties, engineering, operations, commissioning and construction teams, as well as adherence to safety standards.
  • Maintain contact with the Technical Support Manager for alignment of strategies and initiatives.
  • Supervise riser pull-in activities with subcontractors and the client.
  • Monitor and record any deviation from quality standards as per the contract and scope of work.
  • Conduct regular quality inspections of work performed, especially upon completion of each activity.
  • Collect, verify and control all documentation, ensuring the quality of information as well as project requirements.
  • Ensure that all relevant policies, procedures, task plans and checklists are available and communicated.
  • Ensure the delivery of the unit project in compliance with the integrity conditions and standards established by the company.
  • Track time consumed and progress in relation to contracted personnel, rented equipment and consumable consumption.
  • Ensure that the Permit to Work (PTW) system is complied with across all project activities.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Naval, Production, Petroleum or related fields) — BSc/MSc.
  • Active CREA (Regional Council of Engineering and Agronomy).
  • Postgraduate degree or MBA in Project Management (PMP, PMI or equivalent).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills at all levels of the organization.
  • Fluency in English (verbal and written) — essential for interaction with international teams.
  • Solid technical knowledge of FPSO systems and equipment.
  • Proficiency in project planning and control tools (MS Project, Primavera or similar).
  • Knowledge of Integrated Management Systems (IMS) and technical documentation platforms.
  • Familiarity with offshore industry regulations and technical standards.
  • Knowledge of Permit to Work (PTW) system management.

Professional Experience

  • Solid experience in project coordination on FPSOs or large-scale projects in the international oil and gas industry.
  • Experience in activity management on FPSOs.
  • Experience in cost control in the offshore oil and gas sector.
  • Experience in technical maintenance roles and maintenance philosophy on offshore units.
  • Experience in supervising contractors and subcontractors in an offshore environment.
  • Previous experience in FPSO engineering projects (construction, commissioning, operation).
  • Commercial knowledge and experience in contract management.
  • Experience with document management systems and quality control.

Competencies

  • Results-oriented leadership, capable of motivating multidisciplinary teams in a high-pressure environment.
  • Ability to work as part of a team and build solid relationships with clients, contractors and partners.
  • Generalist, dynamic profile capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades

  • Recepcionar todos os clientes, profissionais e usuários
  • Anunciar os visitantes aos setores solicitados
  • Fiscalizar a entrada e saída de pessoas, veículos, prestadores de serviços
  • Monitorar as imagens de locais específicos da Instituição (via circuito interno de imagens)
  • Efetuar atendimento telefônico com direcionamento aos processos conforme necessidade
  • Fazer a comunicação imediata de ocorrência de qualquer anormalidade com relação a pessoas, ou veículos nas proximidades da portaria
  • Zelar para o desenvolvimento das atividades com atenção e objetividade
  • Desempenhar as atribuições pertinentes ao cargo sempre com atenção e respeito a todos os profissionais e visitantes
  • Efetuar diariamente controle de acionamento e desligamento da iluminação das áreas comuns da Instituição, observando os horários e/ou necessidades
  • Auxiliar, quando solicitado e autorizado, os demais colegas da portaria em suas bases administrativas
  • Controlar para que pessoas que não pertençam ao processo ou que não sejam vinculadas a qualquer atividade dos setores da SPDM/PAIS, ingressem nas dependências sem autorização dos Gestores
  • Realizar as atividades das áreas/setores, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição

Qualificações

  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função

Local de trabalho: A.P. 3.3 (Madureira e bairros adjacentes)

Benefícios e Parcerias:

  • Vale Refeição ou Vale Alimentação
  • Assistência Médica por adesão
  • Assistência Odontológica por adesão
  • Disponibilizamos parcerias com Wellhub (Gympass), SESC, Zenklub, faculdades, universidades e farmácias

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Job Duties

We are seeking a hands‑on and qualified AI Agent Architect to design and deploy advanced Agentic AI systems—comprising task‑specific autonomous tools governed by a master agent—to support complex technical decision‑making in industrial environments.

This is a high‑impact individual contributor role for someone who can independently deliver full‑stack intelligent agents that interpret natural language queries and generate precise, context‑aware outputs by interacting with structured and unstructured data, APIs, and analytical engines.

  • Architect and develop a multi‑agent AI framework where autonomous agents coordinate to solve domain‑specific technical queries.
  • Leverage LLMs, NLP, and tool‑based reasoning to automate data extraction, analysis, and insight generation.
  • Build agents capable of integrating with engineering tools, simulators, databases, and knowledge sources.
  • Collaborate with domain experts to align agent behavior with technical expectations and constraints.
  • Implement safeguards to ensure accuracy, traceability, and reliability of AI‑generated outputs.
  • Continuously optimize prompting, agent orchestration, and performance under real‑world conditions.

Qualifications

  • Azure AI Engineer or Azure Data Engineer certification is a plus.
  • AWS experience is nice to have, but not required.

Industry Experience:

  • Oil and gas domain experience is a strong advantage, especially familiarity with digital operations or engineering workflows.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Demonstrated expertise in building Agentic AI architectures, using frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or custom stacks.

  • Advanced Python programming and experience deploying AI workflows in cloud or containerized environments.
  • Ability to work with APIs, data models, and external toolchains across complex systems.
  • Comfortable operating independently with minimal supervision in a cross‑functional environment.

Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to industrial domains such as energy, manufacturing, or heavy engineering.
  • Understanding of vector databases, knowledge graphs, and retrieval‑augmented generation.

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (Ci & Pm)
description:
Role Description

As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed‑plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component‑level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI‑driven capabilities to proactively engage clients to identify risks before they elevate, ensuring consistently measurable results.

With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long‑term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.

  • Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component‑level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission‑criticality.
  • Rules‑Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules‑based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.
  • Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.
  • Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.
  • Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high‑quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety‑first principles and considering operational mission‑criticality.
  • Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.
  • Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on‑condition maintenance changes.
  • Customer Engagement & Follow‑Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow‑up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.
  • Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high‑quality component health management.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands‑on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.
  • Industry Knowledge: Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.
  • Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise: In‑depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity with onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.
  • Linguistic Proficiency: Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.
  • Communication & Leadership: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Assistant Director of Judicial Clerkships & Fellowships will serve as a key member of the law school’s Career Services Office, dedicated to supporting students and alumni seeking to secure judicial clerkships. The Assistant Director will provide comprehensive career counseling, develop strategic partnerships with the judiciary, and oversee programs and initiatives that enhance students\'s and graduates\' competitiveness for clerkship positions. Additionally, this role will play an integral part in identifying and assisting with specialty fellowship development pipelines.

Supervisory Accountability

Supervises student workers, temporary personnel, administrative staff, and volunteers as needed. Reports to the Dean of Career & Professional Development, Lauren Jackson.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff, and students in the School of Law and other University departments. External contacts include judges, organizations focused on judicial placement, serve as liaison to the Judicial Clerkship Committee, and other important contacts as deemed necessary.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Judicial Clerkship Advising: Provide individualized career counseling to students and alumni interested in judicial clerkships, including state, federal, and international positions.
  • Guide students through the application process, including resume and cover letter review, interview preparation, and navigating the OSCAR system (Online System for Clerkship Application and Review).
  • Offer specialized workshops, panels, and informational sessions on the benefits of judicial clerkships and strategies for securing them.
  • Partnership Development: Cultivate relationships with judges, court administrators, and public interest employers to create opportunities for clerkships and public sector employment.
  • Collaborate with alumni who have clerkship experience to build mentoring and networking opportunities for current students.
  • Organize and lead outreach initiatives to enhance the school’s reputation within the judiciary and public interest communities.
  • Assist with developing relationships with prominent fellowship organizations.
  • Program Management: Develop and manage programs that increase students\' and graduates\' exposure to clerkships, such as clerkship boot camps, alumni panels, and judicial internships.
  • Track and analyze data on clerkship placement and public interest employment to assess the effectiveness of programs and adapt strategies accordingly.
  • Administer funding opportunities, including stipends and fellowships, to support students pursuing unpaid clerkships.
  • Manage clerkship resources for the office such as the Vermont Clerkship Guides, NBLSA Judicial Directory, CORA, and other relevant sites.
  • Diversity and Inclusion: Advocate for and support underrepresented students in pursuing clerkships and public interest careers, ensuring they have access to resources and opportunities.
  • Develop initiatives to increase diversity within judicial clerkships, including partnerships with affinity groups and diversity organizations.
  • Collaboration and Leadership: Work closely with faculty, administration, and other career services staff to integrate clerkship advising across the curriculum.
  • Represent the law school at regional and national conferences focused on judicial clerkships and relevant public interest areas.
  • Stay informed of trends and developments in judicial clerkships to provide the most current and relevant advice to students and alumni.
  • Develop a clerkship advisory committee to assist with clerkship application review and advising.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in career services or academic advising in a law school setting.
  • Proven track record of placing students or graduates in judicial clerkships.
  • Active involvement in professional organizations related to judicial clerkships or public interest law.

Minimum Requirements

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Experience in judicial clerkships, either through serving as a clerk or in a related advisory role.
  • Familiarity with fellowship recruiting and application process.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to build relationships with diverse stakeholders, including students, alumni, and judges.
  • Familiarity with the judicial clerkship application process, including OSCAR.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range - $75,000 - $85,000

Nice to have

O Grupo Infoalter é um ecossistema de tecnologia com mais de 6.000 contratos ativos no Brasil, América Latina, Canadá e Portugal. Procuramos um Gerente Comercial que não se contenta com o que já foi construído. Alguém que olha para 6.000 contratos e enxerga oportunidade — e olha para o mercado e enxerga territórios inexplorados.

  • Representar o Grupo Infoalter nos mais de 40 eventos nacionais anuais onde montamos stand para divulgar e vender o Time is Money e o Servidor na Nuvem — sendo a cara da empresa em campo, no lugar do CEO

Qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em gestão comercial B2B com múltiplos produtos ou verticais
  • Histórico sólido tanto em aquisição de novos clientes quanto em expansão e retenção de base
  • Domínio real de CRM — não para registrar, mas para extrair inteligência e guiar o time
  • Experiência em gestão de times comerciais remotos com rituais e disciplina de acompanhamento
  • Capacidade de construir playbooks, metas e processos do zero ou reformular o que existe
  • Conhecimento de métricas comerciais: CAC, LTV, churn, taxa de conversão, ticket médio, forecast
  • Perfil de líder que desenvolve pessoas — com histórico de vendedores que cresceram sob sua gestão
  • Presença forte em eventos — sabe montar stand, abordar, apresentar, vender e fechar em ambiente de feira e congresso
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes por todo o Brasil (mais de 40 eventos por ano)
  • Experiência no setor de tecnologia, SaaS ou software de gestão (diferencial forte)
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e capacidade de influenciar sem hierarquia imposta
  • Sua maior conquista foi vender — mas nunca fez um vendedor crescer
  • Usa CRM só para o gestor cobrar, não para você enxergar o negócio
  • Não gosta ou não tem perfil para eventos e representação presencial

description:
ENGENHEIRO DE CONFIABILIDADE DE EQUIPAMENTOS ROTATIVOS / Rotating Equipment Reliability Engineer

We are seeking a professional for the Rotating Equipment Reliability Engineer position to work at our office located in Rio Corporate Office dedicated to Guyana project (MOG).

Responsibilities and Assignments

  • Technical Authority (MOC/TA & Governance)
    • Evaluate, respond to, and approve MOC/TA requests, technical changes, and deviations, ensuring compliance with MODEC standards and applicable regulations (API/ASME/ISO/ABNT).
    • Issue Technical Notes and Guidelines as a recognized subject matter expert, standardizing practices and lessons learned.
    • Ensure full documentation, traceability, and clear communication with onshore/offshore stakeholders.
  • Performance Monitoring & Improvement (Condition Monitoring)
    • Monitor rotating equipment performance using PDM/CBM techniques: vibration analysis, thermography, and oil analysis (including ferrography and spectroscopy) for early anomaly detection.
    • Oversee and perform Product/Performance Data Monitoring (PDM) services, recommending corrective and preventive actions.
    • Develop and implement condition‑based maintenance (CBM) programs to optimize availability and reduce downtime.
  • Reliability Engineering (RCM/Strategy/MTBF)
    • Develop and implement reliability and maintenance strategies (RCM), with preventive/predictive plans to improve MTBF and lifecycle cost.
    • Perform diagnostics on pumps, centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, gearboxes, and Dry Gas Seal systems; recommend corrective actions.
    • Identify and manage “bad actors,” drive elimination plans, and prioritize investments to sustain reliability improvements.
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
    • Lead RCA for failures and recurring issues using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, TapRooT, etc.); issue actionable reports and verify effectiveness of actions.
    • Conduct component failure analyses (seals, bearings, rotors, gears, shafts) and propose design, operational, or maintenance improvements.
  • Troubleshooting & Technical Support
    • Provide day‑to‑day technical support to Operations and Maintenance to resolve machinery issues, unplanned shutdowns, and control/operating parameter optimizations.
    • Offer guidance for commissioning/start‑up, operations, overhauls, and controls/monitoring upgrades for rotating equipment.
  • Asset Lifecycle & Projects (Design Review & Installations)
    • Support capital projects by reviewing specifications for maintainability and reliability and ensuring correct installation/alignment per API/AGMA/ISO.
    • Support preparation of Technical Risk Assessments (TRA) and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and systems.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering. MBA/Postgraduate in Reliability, Maintenance, or Asset Management is a plus.
  • Experience in rotating equipment operations, maintenance, or reliability in Oil & Gas (offshore/onshore), focusing on centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, pumps, and turbomachinery.
  • Strong knowledge of rotating equipment reliability, RCM, CBM, and PDM services.
  • Hands‑on experience in condition monitoring (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) and failure diagnostics.
  • Demonstrated troubleshooting and field condition monitoring experience.
  • Solid knowledge of API standards (e.g., 610/617/618/670/682/686), machinery design, lubrication, mechanical seals (incl. Dry Gas Seals), rotor dynamics, balancing, alignment, and modal analysis.
  • Working knowledge of international codes and standards (ASME, ANSI, ISO 10816/20816);
  • Deep understanding of rotating equipment: pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal systems, and gearboxes.
  • Vibration analysis certification (e.g., ISO CAT II/III) desired; oil analysis/thermography certifications are advantageous.

Systems & Software

  • Proficiency with CMMS (SAP preferred) and machinery/condition monitoring software.
  • OSIsoft PI System and System 1 knowledge is differential. Advanced Microsoft Office: Power BI is a plus.
  • Advanced English.
  • Active CREA (as applicable for Brazil).

title: OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect
description:
The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ICS, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third‑party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof‑of‑concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, ICS).
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Strategic vision
  • Problem‑solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
description:
Senior Manager, Ceremonies

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC27”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA.

Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ceremonies Project Leadership

  • Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA.
  • Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament.
  • Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover.
  • Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams.
  • Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables.
  • Provide senior decision-making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation.
  • Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC.
  • Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations.
  • Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters.
  • Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy.

Team Leadership

  • Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures.
  • Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness.
  • Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback.
  • Build team structures and optimize collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units.
  • Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution.
  • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams.

Major Ceremonies Oversight

  • Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament
  • Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management

  • Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony.
  • Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way.
  • Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows with internal teams and external agencies.
  • Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines.
  • Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements.
  • Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content.

Planning Scheduling & Documentation

  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams.
  • Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled.
  • Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting.
  • Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts.
  • Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings.
  • Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams.
  • Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies.
  • Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event.
  • Act as the key operational decision-maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies.
  • Direct venue-level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning.

Supplier & Budget Management

  • Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning.
  • Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation.
  • Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing.
  • Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements.
  • Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes.
  • Supervise payments, deliverables and performance reports from entertainment suppliers.

Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison

  • Act as the senior liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE.
  • Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies.
  • Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery.

Venue Readiness & Execution

  • Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns.
  • Direct venue level preproduction processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning.
  • Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event.
  • Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination.
  • Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre event testing and rehearsal phases.

Other Duties

  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by senior managership aligned with project delivery.
  • Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and senior managership briefings.
  • Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament wide entertainment integration.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience.

Experience

  • 7+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events.
  • Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations.
  • Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets.
  • Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies.

Skills & Competencies

  • ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including, RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately.
  • ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments.
  • FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period.
  • COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level.
  • ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines.
  • PROBLEM‑SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure.
  • CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals.
  • INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment
  • CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant.
  • PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools.
  • Experience of Monday.com an advantage.
  • Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus
  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sr
description:
A área de engenharia de dados deve garantir que a organização tenha acesso a dados confiáveis e organizados, possibilitando a criação de insights e a tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais. Ser um agente de transformação, construindo uma plataforma escalável e resiliente, democratizar o acesso aos dados e impulsionar uma cultura orientada por dados. Missão da Vaga: Projetar, construir e manter pipelines robustos de dados, garantindo que as informações fluam de maneira eficiente e segura. Garantir a disponibilidade, qualidade e governança dos dados. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders e time visando promover melhores práticas na manipulação, análise de grandes volumes de dados, otimização de processos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis para ingestão, processamento e transformação de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados para sistemas analíticos;
  • Implantar e gerenciar soluções de armazenamento, incluindo data lakes e data warehouses, em ambientes em nuvem;
  • Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados, aplicando boas práticas de gerenciamento e segurança e FINOPS;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócio e oferecer soluções orientadas por dados;
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, bases de dados e soluções de integração;
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização de arquitetura de dados, utilizando tecnologias de ponta e frameworks modernos;
  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentorar engenheiros de dados juniores e plenos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência comprovada com plataformas de data viz(tableau, power bi e/ou looker);
  • Histórico de liderança ou participação ativa em projetos complexos de integração e migração para nuvem;

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Cloud Computing;
  • Experiência em GCP e seus serviços, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Function, KMS, Secret Manager;
  • DataStream, Vertex AI e GitHub;
  • Experiência em Azure e seus serviços, como Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics e Azure Data Lake Storage;
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento em modelagem de dados, bancos de dados relacionais (ex.: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (ex.: MongoDB, Cassandra);
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e Pyspark (usado para scripts e automação) e SQL (para manipulação e consulta de dados);
  • ETL/ELT: Experiência na construção de pipelines de ETL/ELT para ingestão e transformação de dados;
  • Data Lakes: Conhecimento de arquiteturas de Data Lake, armazenamento e otimização de dados (ex.: Delta Lake);
  • DevOps: Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de DataOps para automação de deploys e monitoramento de fluxos de dados;
  • Segurança e Governança: Entendimento de práticas de segurança em nuvem, criptografia de dados e implementação de políticas de governança;
  • Orquestração de Dados: Uso de ferramentas como Azure Data Factory e/ou Synapse e/ou Airflow/composer para integração e movimentação de dados;
  • Desempenho e Otimização: Experiência em técnicas para melhorar a performance de pipelines de dados e consultas em ambientes distribuídos e não distribuídos;
  • APIs: Conhecimento em extração de dados via APIs RESTful.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações de engenharia de dados nas plataformas GCP e/ou Azure (Professional Data Engineer, Azure Data Engineer Associate).

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico – Bradesco – extensivo a dependentes;
  • PAE - Auxílio financeiro oferecido no caso de dependentes filhos(as) e/ou enteados(as) com deficiência intelectual;
  • Convênio Farmácia. Descontos de até 85%;

  • Seguro de Vida – seguro para todos os colaboradores a partir da data de admissão, sem participação;
  • Extensão das Licenças - Maternidade (total de 180 dias) e Paternidade (total de 20 dias);
  • Vale-Alimentação e/ou Refeição – Caju Benefícios;

Desenvolvimento

O Programa de Estágio funciona em ciclos de contratação. Você está participando do ciclo de Julho. O processo seletivo ocorrerá de Abril a Junho. Dentro da Baker Hughes temos diversas áreas de oportunidade para estagiar. Confira detalhes para a área de Direito.

O estagiário jurídico irá prover suporte à equipe jurídica na América Latina, em relação a uma variedade de questões jurídicas e de compliance na região, podendo eventualmente auxiliar demandas a nível global. As atividades incluem, mas não são limitadas a:

  • Apoiar iniciativas de Compliance, auxiliando na localização de novos procedimentos e treinamentos;
  • Trabalhar com os advogados na interpretação de contratos e orientação estratégica, especialmente em disputas ou questões que surgirem durante a execução do contrato.

Localização

Confira a localização da vaga no momento da candidatura, pois temos diferentes escritórios entre as cidades do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo e Bahia.

Formas de Trabalho

Como estágio, oferecemos Modelos Presencial e Híbrido. Abaixo, confira as 3 opções possíveis de horário de estágio disponíveis, de acordo com sua grade curricular:

  • De segunda a sexta: 08h às 15h;

  • De segunda a sexta: 10h às 17h.

Working with Us

Working at Baker Hughes means being at the forefront of the energy transition. Our people are diverse, ambitious and collaborative. We’re on a mission to redefine the energy sector by unlocking the power of engineering, data and science.

Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Intern / Trainee / Apprentice

Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

title: Mecânico Diesel
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Sua missão:

  • Elaborar planos e executar manutenções.
  • Substituir peças, reparar e testar desempenho de componentes e sistema de veículos.
  • Efetuar diagnósticos e reparos em conjuntos mecânicos, pneumáticos, hidráulicos e elétricos.
  • Realizar serviços de lubrificação dos veículos.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio Completo.
  • Experiência na função.
  • Informática Básica.
  • Atuação em concessionária e formação em técnica em Mecânica Diesel, Mecatrônica e afins, será um diferencial.

Vantagens/Benefícios:

  • Ticket Alimentação-pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família.
  • Assistência Médica-cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama.
  • Assistência Odontológica-cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família.
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral-proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados.
  • Wellhub(Gympass)-incentivo à prática de atividades físicas e ao bem-estar.
  • Telemedicina: Dra.AON| Conexa Saúde-apoio à sua saúde com praticidade e rapidez, sempre que precisar.
  • Premiação anual– reconhecimento pelo seu desempenho.
  • Programa de Desenvolvimento Educacional(PDE)-apoio financeiro einstitucionalpara formações, cursos ou especializações alinhadas às suas atividades e ao desenvolvimento da empresa.
  • Comissionamento- variável conforme a performance eprodutividade.

Para sua comodidade a empresa também oferece Vale Transporte e Uniforme.

A Snapshot of Your Day

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in software development who can design and evolve modern architectures, lead engineers through best practices, and collaborate directly with client stakeholders on solution design and technical decisions. You will set engineering standards for the team, perform code reviews, coach developers, and ensure we deliver secure, reliable, and scalable software.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Define and evolve application architectures (monoliths, microservices, event‑driven), ensuring clear domain boundaries, integration patterns, and API contracts.
  • Lead architectural reviews and technical decision‑making, balancing trade‑offs across scalability, performance, security, and cost.
  • Ensure non‑functional requirements (reliability, observability, security, and performance) are embedded throughout design and delivery.
  • Drive the development of high‑quality .NET services and APIs, setting technical direction for standards, versioning, and documentation.
  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices through code reviews, CI/CD alignment, clean and secure coding standards.
  • Act as a technical leader, mentoring the team, fostering continuous learning, and enabling scalable, observable solutions.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related field.
  • Strong experience in software development and AI experience.
  • Solid architectural knowledge (DDD, CQRS, monolith vs. microservices, event‑driven systems).
  • Proven technical leadership, including code reviews, branching strategies, and guidance on best practices.
  • Deep knowledge of the .NET ecosystem (C#, ASP.NET Core, API design, async programming, relational databases).
  • Experience with cloud environments, containers, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Solid understanding of observability and security fundamentals.
  • Experience collaborating with front‑end teams and applying modern testing practices.
  • Ability to discuss solutions with client architects, negotiate trade‑offs, and justify decisions.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

The specific and existing team takes care of the sales of industrial steam turbines in Latin America in different industries up to a size of 250 MWe.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met optimally and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150‑year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

title: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience
description:
Description

Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing.

We are looking for a Pricing & Payments Manager to lead the Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes function within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization. This role owns the end-to-end strategy and execution of partner pricing models, incentive programs, payment accuracy, and dispute resolution across our Amazon Partner Logistics programs — EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large).

As a People Manager, you will lead and develop a team of specialists, set the strategic direction for pricing and payment mechanisms, build scalable processes, and drive cross-functional alignment with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to ensure partner economics are competitive, accurate, and sustainable.

This position is based out of an Amazon corporate office and may require periodic travel.

If you are passionate about partner economics, operational excellence, and building high-performing teams, you should join our team.

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes specialists, fostering a culture of ownership, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement
  • Own the end-to-end pricing strategy for logistics partners across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL programs, ensuring competitive and sustainable rate structures
  • Design, implement, and optimize incentive programs that drive partner performance, network efficiency, and cost effectiveness
  • Oversee the payment lifecycle — from invoice validation and payment accuracy to dispute identification, root cause analysis, and resolution
  • Build and maintain scalable mechanisms for pricing governance, incentive tracking, payment reconciliation, and dispute management
  • Develop structured reporting and dashboards to monitor pricing competitiveness, incentive ROI, payment accuracy, and dispute aging/resolution rates
  • Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to align pricing models with business objectives and contractual frameworks
  • Identify and drive automation opportunities to reduce manual intervention in payment and dispute processes
  • Conduct periodic pricing benchmarking and market analysis to ensure Amazon's partner economics remain competitive
  • Manage escalations related to partner payments and disputes, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder alignment
  • Define and track KPIs for the team, establishing clear goals, performance standards, and development plans for direct reports

A day in the life

Your day starts with metrics review and team's priorities. Your focus centers on strategic decisions that shape partner economics across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL. You lead cross-functional negotiations with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to align pricing models with business objectives. You assess incentive program ROI, recommending adjustments to optimize cost efficiency and partner performance. You review payment accuracy dashboards, identifying systemic gaps and designing scalable mechanisms to address them. Between meetings, you coach your team on stakeholder influence and data-driven storytelling. Every day balances strategic thinking, cross-functional alignment, and talent development to drive sustainable partner economics at scale.

About The Team

The Pricing & Payments team is part of Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience organization, supporting the EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMXL (Amazon Extra Large), and AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics) programs across Brazil — a network of +30 logistics partners and +300 operational nodes. Our mission is to ensure Amazon's logistics partners operate under competitive, transparent, and accurate pricing and payment frameworks, while driving performance through well-designed incentive programs and efficient dispute resolution. We build scalable pricing models, payment governance mechanisms, and incentive strategies that balance cost efficiency with partner sustainability. The team sits within a broader strategic structure that also covers Compliance & Communications, Network Health & Performance, and VAS & DA Experience — working cross-functionally to support Amazon's Last Mile growth in Brazil.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, operations, logistics, supply chain or engineering
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • Experience managing and developing high performance teams
  • Experience conducting sophisticated and creative analysis of complex data and translate the results into actionable deliverables, messages, and presentations
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams across business development, marketing, operations, product development, legal, etc.
  • Experience implementing scalable compliance solutions (technology, procedures, processes, etc.) in a regulated environment
  • Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English
  • Experience in deal management and pricing strategy, or financial consulting

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA, or Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
  • Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
  • Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques
  • Experience in logistics
  • Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing efforts, transportation and logistics, or fulfillment and distribution centers
  • Experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis, or experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
  • Experience designing incentive programs or performance-based compensation structures
  • Experience building payment reconciliation or dispute management mechanisms at scale

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
Job Overview

In this role, you will be responsible for creating clear, structured, and highly technical documentation for internal engineering systems, partnering closely with senior developers and infrastructure teams. You’ll apply a strong foundation in software engineering along with hands‑on knowledge of cloud and DevOps environments— including Azure GovCloud, infrastructure provisioning with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, PostgreSQL operations and disaster recovery, configuration management, and observability best practices. You’ll produce concise how‑to guides, installation and troubleshooting procedures (PowerShell/Bash), and standardized content organized for developer audiences using defined templates. Success in this role requires proficiency with Confluence, GitHub, Jira, and diagramming tools, plus excellent information architecture skills. You’ll also independently manage limited SME availability through effective interviewing and scheduling, while communicating directly with Directors and Lead Engineers to deliver accurate, user‑friendly documentation.

Required Skills and Expertise

Software Engineering Foundation

  • A deep understanding of software development and engineering principles is a primary requirement.
  • Cloud & DevOps Literacy: The writer must be comfortable documenting highly technical, internal‑facing systems.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Azure (GovCloud/IL4), cloud architecture, Infrastructure as a Service, Terraform, and provisioning.
  • CI/CD: Complex continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
  • Databases: PostgreSQL provisioning, operations, and disaster recovery (DR).

Configuration Management

  • Documenting unified configuration systems and migration from legacy tools.
  • Observability: Writing best practices for monitoring and alerting.

Core Documentation & Writing Skills

  • Clarity and Conciseness: The ability to create clear, concise, and user‑friendly documentation.
  • Procedural Writing: The writer must be able to create clear how‑to guides, particularly for installation (using PowerShell/Bash) and troubleshooting.
  • Information Architecture: The project requires standardizing formats and organizing content logically for a developer audience (e.g., "Onboarding," "Infrastructure," "Troubleshooting") to improve findability.
  • Template Adherence: The writer must be able to follow specific templates, such as the MSF Docs Single Page Design, which outlines a precise structure for content.

Tool Proficiency

  • Content Platforms: Confluence and GitHub as the primary documentation platforms.
  • Collaboration Tools: Familiarity with Jira for project tracking and Lucidchart (or similar) for diagrams if necessary.

Soft Skills

  • SME Management: Managing the limited availability of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) is a primary risk.
  • Strong interviewing skills and the ability to work independently to proactively schedule and manage SME time.

Stakeholder Communication

The role requires collaborating directly with senior engineering stakeholders, including Directors and Lead Software Engineers.

Benefits

  • Flexible working format—remote, office‑based or flexible
  • Competitive salary and compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location‑specific benefits
  • Not applicable for freelancers

L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a "Criar a beleza que move o mundo"; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo. Na Divisão de Grande Público, nossa missão é democratizar o melhor da beleza, que significa levar a beleza para todos. E para nós, a beleza deve ser sustentável. A Divisão de Grande Público porta a marca número 1 de beleza no mundo com L'Oréal Paris, a marca número 1 de maquiagem comMaybellineNew York, a marca natural número 1 com Garnier. A DPGP é a maior divisão do grupo L'Oréal, com mais de 30 mil colaboradores ao redor do mundo. A área Comercial é o coração pulsante da L’Oréal, uma verdadeira força motriz por trás do sucesso das nossas marcas! A nossa equipe é composta por profissionais estratégicos, criativos e orientados para resultados, que trabalham em parceria com nossos clientes e as áreas do business para impulsionar o crescimento do nosso negócio. Missão

Buscamos um(a) Executivo(a) de Contas com a capacidade de liderar o atendimento a clientes do Canal Farma Direto, garantindo excelência em todas as áreas e assuntos que envolvam o desenvolvimento da L'Oréal Grande Público no canal.

Principais Atividades:

  • Desenvolver e construir relacionamento com os Clientes do Canal Farma e Time L’Oréal, fazendo gestão dos KPIs de negócio (implementação das Estratégias da Companhia), garantindo que cumpramos a nossa missão com o Consumidor Final. Principais stakeholders (Trade Marketing, Marketing, Customer Care/Supply, Gestão / Finanças e Crédito e Cobrança );
  • Garantir a entrega do Sell Out desenhado em plano (JBP) e, consequentemente, a geração do Sell In necessário para o correto gerenciamento de estoque e abastecimento;
  • Com o apoio da área de Trade Marketing, garantir a execução do Calendário Promocional (ações de Sell Out), dentro do investimento disponível, respeitando e garantindo a correta execução do processo interno de prestação de Contas (dentro dos prazos e valores acordados);

Dar visibilidade à Companhia do cenário atual de Mercado e possível previsão de futuro (médio e longo prazo).

Conhecimentos Necessários:

  • Sólida experiência Comercial no canal FarmaDiretocom produtos de Bens de Consumo ou Beleza/Higiene Pessoal;

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

title: Service Engineer E&I
description:
As a Technical Supervisor Electrical & Instrumentation , you play a crucial coordinating role in ensuring the safety, reliability and quality of our electrical LV/HV installations and electrical work equipment across all our sites and vessels.

Rather than a purely hands‑on technician position, this is a supervisory and organisational role , focused on electrical safety, compliance, inspections, documentation, and the correct execution of work by internal staff and subcontractors.

You will work across our offices and yards: Heijningen (workshop), Rotterdam (warehouse), Eindhoven (Research & Development) and Enschede (fabrication). Occasionally, you will travel offshore to support our vessels.

Your most important responsibilities

Electrical safety & compliance

  • Ensure the safe operation of all LV/HV electrical installations and electrical work equipment.
  • Develop, implement and safeguard policies regarding electrical safety in accordance with applicable standards and legislation.
  • Establish and maintain access regulations for areas with electrical hazards.
  • Organise and coordinate periodic inspections of installations and equipment.
  • Ensure timely remediation of any identified defects.
  • Conduct electrical safety risk analyses and internal audits to continuously improve safety and reliability.

Procedures & documentation

  • Prepare work procedures for operation, maintenance and inspection; include procedures for isolation and making installations inactive.
  • Keep technical documentation up to date and maintain records of incidents and relevant work activities.
  • Collect and provide information for as‑built drawings and diagrams.

Coordination & supervision

  • Supervise electrical activities carried out by subcontractors and third parties.
  • Ensure safe, efficient and compliant execution of works on board and on site.
  • Coordinate with internal technical staff and advise crew where required.
  • Appoint competent and qualified personnel and ensure training and instruction needs are met.
  • Prepare annual and multi‑year (5‑10 year) maintenance, improvement, and modification budgets in collaboration with budget holders and internal stakeholders.
  • Draft technical specifications for new or upgraded installations.

Support & cooperation

  • Support equipment electricians with troubleshooting and maintenance activities when required.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of systems, procedures and technologies used within the organisation.

What we expect from you

  • Good command of English and Dutch; many technical documents are in Dutch.
  • Minimum MBO degree in electrical engineering or equivalent.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in a similar role within an industrial environment.
  • Experience within offshore, dredging, construction or shipbuilding industry is a great asset.
  • Knowledge of relevant legislation and standards (e.g. Arbowet, NEN 1010).
  • NEN 3140/3840 IV or WV certification or willingness to obtain; STIPEL certification is a strong asset.
  • Accurate, flexible and cost‑aware professional with a creative attitude.
  • Willingness to occasionally travel and work abroad or offshore.

What we offer

  • Competitive industry‑benchmark salary and excellent pension.
  • Performance‑based salary raises and bonuses.
  • 30 holiday days per year, flexible working hours.
  • Extensive training and development programme, study budgets and coaching.
  • Company‑sponsored fitness scheme.
  • Internal clubs, committees, parties and sporting events.

Position Summary

The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business‑partnering role responsible for portfolio‑level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders.

Main Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own and deliver portfolio‑level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification.
  • Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls.
  • Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks.
  • Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project‑level data feeding portfolio reporting.
  • Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions.
  • Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios.
  • Provide forward‑looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards.
  • Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost).
  • Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review.
  • Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations.
  • Support ad‑hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management.
  • Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting.

Minimum Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience.
